label: explicit_diagnosis_compatible
rationale: SS is explicitly among chemotherapy-sensitive high-grade STS types suitable for neoadjuvant/adjuvant treatment and resection.
cohort_reconciliation: One perioperative pathway requires multidisciplinary determination of resectability; unresectable sarcoma is excluded. This is not an unrestricted metastatic salvage study.
extra_biomarker_requirement: No molecular entry criterion is stated. Grade, treatment sensitivity/suitability and investigator judgment are separate requirements.
protocol_uncertainty: Radiation eligibility units differ from the stated fractionation; source references randomization despite a single-arm design. Age 18–75, organ function, recent therapy and other restrictions remain. External protocol and live availability are unverified; phase 4 coding is not evidence of indication approval.
quotes: Typically includes histological types such as synovial sarcoma
Clinical confirmation of soft tissue sarcoma suitable for surgical resection after multidisciplinary assessment.
Unresectable sarcomas, including severe vascular, neural, or bone involvement, or cases where complete surgical resection is not safely feasible.

label: explicit_diagnosis_compatible
rationale: SS is explicitly eligible for pulmonary surgical imaging despite the narrower osteosarcoma official title.
cohort_reconciliation: Single Cytalux/NIR imaging pathway during planned pulmonary metastasectomy, requiring suspicious pulmonary disease and at least one nodule of 4 mm or more. This is a diagnostic adjunct study, not a systemic antitumor therapy trial.
extra_biomarker_requirement: No positive folate-receptor assay is required in the saved criteria; mechanistic rationale does not establish receptor expression in an SS patient.
protocol_uncertainty: Age 6–17 and weight at least 20 kg; a 12th or 18th birthday during participation is excluded. An inclusion-style male contraception sentence appears under exclusions and requires clarification rather than inferred sex exclusion. External protocol and live availability are unverified; pediatric safety/effectiveness is not established by adult-source extrapolation.
quotes: Histologically confirmed diagnosis of osteosarcoma, synovial sarcoma, hepatoblastoma, rhabdomyosarcoma, Ewing sarcoma, Wilms tumor or other non-rhabdomyosarcoma soft tissue sarcoma
Participants will be excluded if their 12th or 18th birthday would occur during study participation

label: explicit_diagnosis_compatible
rationale: SS is explicitly an example of eligible metastatic sarcoma in Part 1. Part 2 separately permits sarcoma under non-metastatic operative requirements.
cohort_reconciliation: Part 1 studies metastatic sarcoma dosimetry and tissue comparison; Part 2 excludes metastatic/inoperable disease and requires surgery within sixty days with tissue collection. Part 2 exclusions cannot be applied to Part 1.
extra_biomarker_requirement: Suspected FAP expression is required; archived/new-biopsy or surgical tissue is needed by part. No positive pre-entry IHC cutoff is specified. Imaging/IHC correlation is an outcome, not verified expression or a radiotherapeutic benefit.
protocol_uncertainty: Age at least 15, with weight at least 55 kg for ages 15–17, plus renal/cardiac and imaging/washout criteria remain. External protocol and current part availability are unverified. Past estimated completion dates do not override saved RECRUITING status or establish present recruitment.
quotes: Patients with suspected FAP-expressing metastatic sarcoma.
Evidence of metastatic or advanced, inoperable disease.

label: broad_tumor_compatible
rationale: The explicit SS Indication C is marked closed. The separately open Indication E permits any sarcomas or other solid tumors and is the remaining broad histologic route; it is not an active SS-specific efficacy cohort.
cohort_reconciliation: A–D arms are marked closed, including SS C. E assesses concentration-QTc and drug interactions after standard options are exhausted or refused. The summary still says ASPS only and no SS recruitment, conflicting with open E. Broad E scope is therefore retained with unresolved availability, rather than using the historical SS title as current inclusion or treating all SS as excluded.
extra_biomarker_requirement: No additional tumor molecular gate is stated for E; CYP/transporter probe studies are pharmacokinetic measurements, not tumor eligibility markers.
protocol_uncertainty: External protocol is needed to reconcile ASPS-only text versus open E and the legacy other-primary-cancer exclusion. Age at least 18 and clinical restrictions remain. SS AL3818 arm is mis-mapped to dacarbazine in source; no regimen correction is invented. Saved RECRUITING does not prove SS slots. Independent adjudication should examine this scope/status conflict.
quotes: Open Indication E: Any sarcomas or other solid tumors
Indication C: SS AL3818 Arm - CLOSED
